name: kind-port
title: Open the kind port: user-defined subagents
description: Project-level kind definitions in .pi/Coworkflow/agents/<kind>.md: override a shipped kind's role/prompt/label/model, add new kinds, rename the agent, set defaults. Hot-reloads on /reload. A /Coworkflow:kind command and a public RPC write the same definitions so any user or agent can DIY.
